name: "🚀 Submit / Share a Rule (分享規則)"
about: "Share a SYNC code for a site you've trained, or request a new site."
title: "[Rule] Site Name (e.g., example.com)"
labels: "rule-submission"
assignees: ""
---

### 🌐 網站網址 (Website URL)
*(可以把關鍵字打上星號防審查，例如 p**nhub.com)*
> 

### 📋 規則分享碼 (SYNC Code)
*(如果您已經自己訓練成功，請在 V-Train 面板點擊「Share (序號複製)」，並將代碼貼在下方)*
> 

### 🖼️ 影片封面截圖 CSS Selector (選填)
*(如果網站收藏時容易破圖，請提供影片預覽圖的 CSS，例如 `video` 或 `img.cover`)*
> 

### 📝 其他補充 (Additional Notes)
> 

---
**English:**
If you have successfully trained a new site, please click "Share" in your V-Train rule management panel and paste the `SYNC-Z...` code above. Community maintainers will review and merge it into the global database!
